status: HTTP caching selected by the user; standards review complete; course authored in independent app source files.

recommended.name: HTTP Cache
recommended.reason: 现有 HTTP 课没有 ETag、If-None-Match 或 304，浏览器缓存是明确的深入主题；复用 HTTP 的设备、路线和文本字节编码即可完成最小课程。

coverageAudit.existingCoverage: http 课只有请求准备、DNS、TCP、HTTP交换、渲染；WebSocket/Portal 有零散 Cache-Control 字面量，但没有缓存新鲜度/条件请求流程。
coverageAudit.decision: 推荐：新增内容清晰，扩展成本最低。

coverageAudit.existingCoverage: IP/ICMP 课讲寻址、NAT、TTL、ping/traceroute/unreachable；IPv6 RA 提及 MTU，但没有独立PMTUD流程。
coverageAudit.decision: 适合下一课：需补ICMP fragmentation-needed/next-hop MTU及相应wire字段，不是首个最小接入。

coverageAudit.existingCoverage: DNS 现有 Answer & Cache 步骤已显示TTL3600、resolver与laptop缓存，outro也解释后续直接从缓存回答。
coverageAudit.decision: 可深入负缓存或TTL过期，但基础缓存选题与现课重复较多。

learningObjectives: 区分从浏览器私有缓存本地复用与向源站验证；本地 fresh 命中不产生HTTP网络报文。
识别 Cache-Control/max-age 与 ETag 的不同职责：新鲜度时间窗口与表示验证器。
理解 If-None-Match 对条件GET的含义；匹配时304复用已保存正文，不匹配时200传新正文。
在检查器中找到请求行、响应状态、Date、Cache-Control、ETag、If-None-Match与真实正文偏移。
识别 no-cache、no-store、must-revalidate 的区别，以及不能验证时的限制。

topology.cacheLocation: Client/browser private cache; not a new intermediary device.
topology.reuse: Existing laptop/router/cloud/server SVG, routing client>web, HTTP text encoder.
topology.disclosure: Plain HTTP/1.1 is used to make bytes visible; HTTP cache semantics also apply to HTTPS. DNS/connection establishment may be summarized; long simulated waits do not imply that real servers keep every TCP connection open.

suggestedSteps.title: Fetch and Store
suggestedSteps.goal: 无本地表示，发送GET并接收可存储200。
keyMessages: HTTP/1.1 200 OK; ETag: "lesson-v1"; Cache-Control: private, max-age=60, must-revalidate
suggestedSteps.result: 保存正文v1和元数据；模拟t=0接收。

suggestedSteps.title: Fresh Cache Hit
suggestedSteps.goal: 模拟10秒后再读相同资源，缓存仍fresh。
suggestedSteps.result: 直接使用已存正文，不新增packet/stream。必须在note文本里标明模拟10秒后，因为现有时序器不会使用note.time。

suggestedSteps.title: Ask Only If Changed
suggestedSteps.goal: 超过60秒后发带验证器的条件GET。

suggestedSteps.title: 304, Keep the Body
suggestedSteps.goal: 源站表示仍匹配，发无正文304。
keyMessages: HTTP/1.1 304 Not Modified; Date: ...; ETag: "lesson-v1"; Cache-Control: private, max-age=60, must-revalidate
suggestedSteps.result: 更新响应元数据，继续使用原正文；304不是一次本地命中，也不是重新下载正文。

suggestedSteps.title: Changed Means 200
suggestedSteps.goal: 再次超过验证后的新鲜期限，旧ETag不匹配源站v2。
suggestedSteps.result: 新的200替换已存表示和验证器。第二次过期应在304日期/接收时间之后再超过60秒，不能仍按首次200算。

suggestedSteps.title: Cache Rules and Failures
suggestedSteps.result: 最小版可用讲解与事实表表达；不要把注释伪装成实际错误响应报文。若绘制504，需要明确是执行验证的缓存生成，不能画源站不可达时从源站凭空返回504。

exampleFixtures.encoding: Header lines use CRLF and a final empty line. Existing data.text + data.body can encode known ASCII body bytes; data.http.body generates unknown placeholder bytes. Use text/body when illustrating exact message bytes. No Content-Length is needed on 304; omit it to avoid teaching an incorrect zero length.
exampleFixtures.frameSize: Compute actual Ethernet/IP/TCP plus serialized application bytes via helpers; do not manually copy response message byte count into row.len, which is a frame-level label.

standards.verified: Fresh stored responses can satisfy an eligible request without contacting the origin. Freshness compares response age with freshness lifetime.
max-age is in seconds; it is not a directive to delete data after that time.
A cache validates using stored validators; provided entity tags are sent as preconditions.
Entity tags are opaque validators assigned by the origin, not necessarily content hashes.
Uses weak comparison; a false condition on GET/HEAD leads to304, on other methods to412. This lesson uses simple strong-looking tags with a conditionalGET.
304 has no content or trailers. Include Date, ETag, Cache-Control and other specified fields that the corresponding200 would send.
Use the validation response to update applicable stored metadata; preserve the cached body.
After becoming stale, cannot reuse until successful validation; disconnected validation cannot be bypassed.
Unqualified response no-cache requires validation before reuse; it does not mean storage is prohibited.
Prohibits intentional storage/reuse in the normal case; do not describe it as guaranteed privacy or wiping all previous caches.
Unqualified private permits eligible private-cache storage and prohibits shared-cache storage.

reviewChecklist: Fresh-hit step contains no packet/stream and does not add a fake network200.
ConditionalGET uses the ETag from the most recently stored selected representation.
304 data has no body field or trailer; no encoded body bytes exist.
304 carries the example Date/ETag/Cache-Control that corresponding200 would carry.
An ETag mismatch yields200 withv2 body and ETag, not304.
Second stale interval is measured after successful validation, not initial fetch.
Content-Length equals encoded body byte length, not character count for arbitrary Unicode.
Cache age calculations in narration account for Date/Age/network delay or explicitly use simplified assumptions away from the expiry boundary.
Original Rw ignores note.time; simulate passage of time in notes and later packet timestamps, without claiming a timestamped note is laid out at that time.
Do not imply full browser cache implementation, all Vary variants, ServiceWorker caches, CDN policy, ranges or every validator behavior are simulated.
sourceBoundary: Coverage conclusions derive from the recorded original public bundle; RFC conclusions from official RFC Editor pages. The app course is a deterministic teaching trace, not a live browser cache implementation.

implementation.localVerification: Imported course; asserted message lengths, Content-Length=16, body-free304, fresh step without packets,6steps/9rows and narrative translation coverage. Browser integration is verified by parent agent.
